scope: Interface specification for the early-layer receiver-recovery study; not a full code or raw-results archive.

two_object_prompts.SYSTEM: You compress object descriptions into a fixed public vocabulary. You will be given a vocabulary of words and a description of two objects. For each object, choose up to four vocabulary words that the description explicitly supports. Use only words from the vocabulary, spelled exactly as given. Do not invent facts. Answer with one JSON object and nothing else.

four_object_prompts.SYSTEM4: You compress object descriptions into a fixed public vocabulary. You will be given a vocabulary of words and a description of four objects. For each object, choose up to four vocabulary words that the description explicitly supports. Use only words from the vocabulary, spelled exactly as given. Do not invent facts. Answer with one JSON object and nothing else.

receiver.instruction_and_demonstrations:
Answer with exactly one object name on one line.
DEMOX is large. DEMOY is small.
Q: Which object is large?
A: DEMOX

DEMOX is smooth. DEMOY is rough.
Q: Which object is rough?
A: DEMOY
receiver.object_declarations: For each alias: "{alias} is an object."; concatenate with spaces.
receiver.public_message_header: Selected words and exact relative weights (integers divided by 255):
receiver.chat: Native user-message chat template, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False; plain prompt for Base.
receiver.write: At the selected decoder block output, replace selected neutral fact-position states by saved neutral states plus gamma times the local word direction; gamma=1, all weights=255.

fitting.construction: Insert only the target word; other positions unknown. Replace every target token by the single unknown token for the neutral comparison. Read the final target token, subtract neutral, average twelve contrasts in float64, store float32. No row normalization.
